answer: Require each new identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if its attestations are spot-checked and found wrong. A fake account then costs real capital plus exposure to penalties, so the nadir of a sybil farm's profit falls below zero as it scales. Honest agents lock once, attest correctly, and keep the stake, so the signal they send stays cheap, while a tundra of idle fakes only freezes funds.
